'''Pokémon Ranger and the Prince of the Sea: Manaphy Music Collection''' is the original Japanese soundtrack CD of the 9th Pokémon movie, ''[[M09|Pokémon Ranger and the Temple of the Sea]]''. It was released in Japan on July 26, 2006.
